title: Christian Medical College, Vellore v. Union of India

content.caseIdentity: Christian Medical College, Vellore v. Union of India, (2020) 8 SCC 705
content.holding: The Court upheld the application of NEET to minority medical institutions as a regulatory measure directed to merit, transparency and standards.
content.relevance: Important authority on professional education and uniform regulatory standards.

evidence.note: Supreme Court of India 2020 INSC 354; (2020) 8 SCC 705; NEET examination applicability to minority unaided institutions.
